text: Core triage 2026-09-12 (user-authorized): Promote the B-spline basis/estimand contract review. Current bsplineBasis drops the first column; constant-response and noninteger-knot assumptions need an independent oracle and explicit policy. Do not blindly change causal/normalization conventions merely to match another library. Disposition: open, P1, core-correctness. This is backlog triage, not new implementation/testing or upstream publication.
